recipes.title: Vertical editor tour on an accent field with whip moves
recipes.summary: A desktop editor is shown in a 9:16 frame as a dark window band on a saturated accent field; the camera never rests, pushing into panels, whipping between features with motion blur, then a typed brand line and URL close on black.
use_when: A desktop or web tool needs a vertical promo for short-form social feeds
The product flow is a sequence of clicks: browse, pick, edit, prompt, export
Silent autoplay: the UI and typed copy carry the message without VO
A real screen capture or a rebuilt UI is available for 6-10 surfaces

recipes.title: Single button press with ambient colour flare
recipes.summary: A prompt bar with one dark pill button idles on a pale drifting gradient; a cursor glides in, presses with a squash, the sparkle icon collapses and the whole background flares saturated blue-violet, then slowly calms.
use_when: The press of one AI action button is the moment to sell
A short vertical loop for a feature page or social post with no copy beyond the button label
An insert between a prompt-typing shot and the result shot of a longer film
Calm, premium product voice where a colour shift replaces a loud effect

recipes.title: Caption-led phone and assistant chat tour
recipes.summary: Short centred captions on black alternate with product moments: a 3D phone spins in, a tilted sign-up screen glides, an assistant chat types and streams, a payment flow confirms. A violet horizon arc sweeps and brightens toward the logo.
use_when: A consumer or fintech mobile app with two or three screens and an in-app assistant
Silent autoplay where small captions announce each feature before it is shown
Showing an AI answer that turns into one concrete action with a confirm
Dark, restrained brand with a single violet or brand-colour glow

recipes.title: Archive photo montage into blue-glow UI tour
recipes.summary: Fast black-and-white office photos set up the struggle, a typed line on black turns the corner, then a blue-lit product tour: laptop push-in, multiplayer editor, a glowing button flipping in edge-on, a post, URL, mark.
use_when: A founder or startup-program launch that opens on the hard, human side before showing the tool
A video or design tool with collaboration and an export step to show
A silent autoplay film that needs one strong colour (electric blue) to carry the product half
Contrasting a grey past with a lit present in one film

recipes.title: Award badge with letter wave in and out
recipes.summary: A white award badge with an accent border sits centred on flat charcoal. A medal icon pops in, then a two-line award label rises letter by letter out of a clip mask, holds, and leaves letter by letter. 3 s, loops cleanly.
use_when: Announcing a ranking, award or launch-day placement on social
A short loop to embed in a post, a site header or the end of a longer film
Milestone posts where one label and one number carry the message
Silent autoplay feeds: no sound or VO needed

recipes.title: Endless icon carousel with badge counts
recipes.summary: Five rounded app tiles glide left in an endless row at constant speed; twice a red badge pops onto one tile, counts up, then shrinks away. A seamless 10 s loop that says the product sits among the tools people use.
use_when: An integrations or ecosystem beat: the product lives next to tools the viewer knows
A seamless loop for a landing page hero, waitlist or social card
Showing activity (unread items, alerts) without any UI rebuild
A family of apps or cards presented as equals

recipes.title: Mark slices into bands and snaps back
recipes.summary: A still monochrome mark on black splits into horizontal bands that slide apart, ghost and lock back into place in under a second, then holds. A short, loopable logo sting that reads as motion without leaving the mark.
use_when: a 1-2 s logo sting or loop for socials or a site header
the close of a longer film where the mark should twitch, not fly in
a mark built from straight or stepped horizontal shapes that survive slicing

recipes.title: Bento pull-out: hero tile to full claim grid
recipes.summary: One hero tile fades up close on a white frame, then the camera pulls out while eight claim tiles slide inward and lock into a bento grid around it. The calm settle and long hold let a dense wall of proof points read as one statement.
use_when: A launch slide that has to show many short proof points at once (materials, specs, certifications)
Closing a product film on one summarising frame
Silent autoplay where one held frame must carry the message
A restrained, premium tone with light backgrounds and product photos

recipes.title: Glyph-eyed blob crowd into dotted claim and lockup
recipes.summary: One pale round face with type-glyph eyes pulls out from macro, blinks through expressions, gets crowded by coloured faces, then the crowd collapses to dots that trace a short number claim and resolve into a three-colour event lockup.
use_when: A playful event or launch-day teaser with a friendly, character-led voice
A silent short where one numeric claim and a name lockup are the whole message
Brands with a 4-5 colour accent palette that can be shown as characters
Opening sting before a longer keynote or launch-week recap

recipes.title: Block-caret prompt with swapping slot and app tile
recipes.summary: A glowing block caret types and erases the name, types a three-line terminal-style promise whose bracketed noun swaps under a glowing selection, types a short call to action, then hard-cuts to the app tile on a violet haze.
use_when: Developer tools, CLIs or coding agents that want a terminal voice
A 10 s intro or bumper where one sentence plus a variable noun carries the pitch
Showing breadth (many things you can make) without any UI
Closing on an app icon rather than a wordmark

recipes.title: Block-decode headline over a dot-screen globe
recipes.summary: A square two-colour event poster: a three-line headline decodes glyph by glyph from solid blocks through coarse mosaic to crisp type in 1.7 s, over a static dot-screened globe, then holds 2.3 s.
use_when: Announcing an event, date or launch day as a square social post
A retro print or texture look with only two brand colours
A short loop where the type entrance is the only motion
Turning a static key visual into a 4 s animated poster

recipes.title: Colour block grid clears to footage headline
recipes.summary: A flat brand-colour field breaks into large square blocks that vanish in steps, uncovering street footage; a three-line caps headline stacks in bottom-left in the accent colour, settles to white and rides over a hard cut to a second clip.
use_when: Opening a news, editorial or social clip with a branded wipe into footage
Revealing a product shot or hero image from a solid brand colour
Short vertical or 4:5 feed posts that need a recognisable branded transition
Any two-clip sequence where one headline stays on top across the cut

recipes.title: Status board row-flip loop
recipes.summary: A black status board of five label/value rows under a split wordmark. Rows roll to a second copy set one by one, top to bottom, while an amber arrow dashes right and creeps back. Reads like a transit board and loops seamlessly.
use_when: Announcing a collection, release or schedule as a list of short label/value facts
Bilingual or two-message loops where the same rows swap copy in place
Travel, transport, logistics or event products that want a timetable voice
Silent autoplay loops for a site hero or social feed

recipes.title: Capped bar rise with outline stat
recipes.summary: Five flat colour bars with detached white caps rise together from a baseline while their values count up, the header lifts to the top and an outline growth figure steps in. One move, then a long readable hold.
use_when: A square stat card for a monthly or quarterly growth number
Opening a data story with one headline figure backed by five values
A silent social post where the chart must read in under 3 s
Dashboard or report teasers with a flat, poster-like palette

recipes.title: Caps punch statements to an accent name reveal
recipes.summary: One line on black, a cut to light grey, then half-sentences built word by word that each land on a single uppercase punch word. An eyebrow and an accent-coloured name reveal follow, three short claims, and a wordmark with a tagline close.
use_when: A problem-to-promise story told with type only, before any UI is worth showing
Silent autoplay where each sentence must split into a setup and a one-word payoff
Naming a product with one accent colour on an otherwise neutral light film
A 15-20 s teaser for a simple tool with three verb claims

recipes.title: Dark card close-ups pulling out to a status line
recipes.summary: Two tight crops of a near-black payment card, each with an oversized wordmark that lights up and fades to a hairline outline, then a cut out to the whole card and a one-line status message that slowly grows over it.
use_when: A fintech or banking launch where a physical or virtual card is the hero
A premium, quiet 1:1 product moment with no UI to show
Closing a longer film on a delivered or activated state
A silent autoplay loop where the wordmark must carry the brand

recipes.title: Card strip step-slide into scattered orbit
recipes.summary: A row of full-bleed image cards steps sideways one card at a time on light grey, punches in once, then hard-cuts to the same five cards scattered in a ring that turns one revolution with a colour-fringe edge.
use_when: Showing 4 to 6 portfolio images, posters or product shots without any copy
A vertical social teaser for a template, design or merch drop
A gallery beat inside a longer film where the visuals carry the message
Silent autoplay where motion alone must hold attention

recipes.title: Caret to claims slide tour
recipes.summary: A caret blinks on black, types a two-line capability claim, then the whole stage slides sideways to an image-editing card cluster and on to a second claim before a small wordmark. One continuous lateral move links features without cuts.
use_when: Demoing two or three AI capabilities in one continuous take, no hard cuts
Vertical social teaser where type carries most of the message and one UI moment proves it
Generative image or video tools that can show one output card with its prompt
Silent autoplay feeds: every claim is on screen long enough to read

recipes.title: Line collapses into a prompt, then mark and typed URL
recipes.summary: A small opener line squeezes into a caret, a huge prompt field types the promise, the camera snaps out to a pill, the chrome falls away, then a drawn mark, a credit line and a typed URL. Silent except real key clicks.
use_when: An AI or text-to-anything product whose promise fits one typed prompt
A short silent teaser or social loop under 12 s
A minimal dark sign-off that needs mark plus URL without an end-card layout
Brands with a simple geometric mark that can be drawn on in strokes

recipes.title: Caret word replace on white
recipes.summary: A lone caret drops in on white, a name builds letter by letter from the caret, then a second phrase types out on the caret's left while the first word erases on its right. One caret does both jobs in 3 s.
use_when: Swapping a product name for its category or a one-line definition
A 3 s silent opener or sticker loop before a longer film
Type-only social posts where the brand has no UI to show yet
Rewriting one term into another: old way to new way, name to tagline

recipes.title: Category lockup tour with flipping cards
recipes.summary: A fixed wordmark gains one category word per section: a chip grows into full-bleed footage, a cover wall pushes in, puzzle cards flip off a stack, photos swing flat from tilted planes. Ends on a light statement and the bare mark.
use_when: A bundle or subscription with 4-6 distinct content categories to name one by one
The brand mark is short enough to sit beside a swapped category word
You have strong full-bleed photos or footage per category plus a few UI cards
A calm, premium, silent-autoplay brand film of about 30 s

recipes.title: Centre-out bar funnel with live counters
recipes.summary: Five stacked colour bars appear as hairlines on the centre axis, then widen symmetrically into a descending funnel while each big figure counts up and settles. A small header moves to the top as the bars arrive.
use_when: Showing three to five headline metrics as a ranking or funnel in one frame
A short silent social post or slide insert that ends on a readable stat poster
Comparing values that differ by orders of magnitude (width encodes rank, not scale)
A data beat inside a longer film where the last frame must hold

recipes.title: Changelog accordion with panel wipe
recipes.summary: A bold title card on a saturated colour opens into three update categories; a white panel wipes up and each category unfolds its three items in turn, then folds away. The update log reads as one calm, paced list.
use_when: A what's-new or release-notes post for a social feed
Three groups of updates with up to three short items each
A silent autoplay vertical or 4:5 placement where text carries the message
A recurring changelog series that needs one reusable template

recipes.title: Two-sided chat thread with typing pills
recipes.summary: A vertical chat builds top-down on white: each message starts as a pill with pulsing dots, the pill stretches to the bubble size, then its words rise in. Five messages alternate grey left and blue right, one every ~2.8 s.
use_when: Telling a product story as a short dialogue between two people or a user and an agent
Vertical social posts where the conversation itself is the content
Opening a messaging, support or assistant product film before the real UI
Silent autoplay: every line is read on screen, no VO needed

recipes.title: Colour lineup slide-in cascade
recipes.summary: Seven side-profile desktop units in seven colours slide in from the right one after another on a near-white field; the row re-spaces as each joins and settles into an even lineup that holds. Calm, keynote-style variant reveal.
use_when: Hardware or product with several colour or model variants
A short silent loop or opener for a lineup announcement
A light, minimal keynote voice with no copy on screen
A bridge shot before a variant picker or pricing line

recipes.title: Concentric progress rings fill on a stat card
recipes.summary: A white stat card grows from a point, three nested progress rings sweep on from twelve o'clock beside three ratio figures, hold for over a second, then the arcs retract and the card fades back to an empty canvas, so it loops.
use_when: Showing two to four goal-vs-actual figures at once in an analytics or reporting product
A short loopable dashboard widget moment for a feed, landing page or slide
An insert inside a longer film where one card has to prove a result
Light SaaS brands with three distinct accent colours

recipes.title: Prompt chips to a running pipeline
recipes.summary: A dark prompt card gets a task, the camera pushes onto its context chip and pans across two dropdowns, then a tile library pulls out under a build button and a status-dot pipeline lights up stage by stage.
use_when: An AI or vision tool where the user picks sources and a model before a job runs
Showing setup (prompt, device, camera) and the resulting run in under 7 s
Small UI that must stay legible: the camera pushes in instead of scaling the UI
A serious, no-bounce product voice: 2-3 fr fades and damped camera moves

recipes.title: Counter over a three-line traced chart, mark close
recipes.summary: A big headline figure races up and settles while three coloured series trace across a dark chart one after another; the chart gives way to a dim oversized mark that lights up and shrinks, then a wordmark slides in as the mark breaks away.
use_when: A monthly or yearly recap with one headline figure and up to three growth series
Proving traction with a single number before the brand close
A silent social clip where the chart must read without VO
Dark product brands with a three-colour data palette

recipes.title: Dark laptop pose reel with beat words
recipes.summary: A dark laptop on charcoal: one word per beat above the closed lid, then five poses (swing-open, two ramped pushes, front lid-open, spin-up fly-in), each with a new screen; brand word and a two-word line close.
use_when: A desktop or web product that wants a premium hardware-style teaser
Five hero screenshots, each worth its own camera pose
Short brand teaser where the screen lighting up is the reveal
Dark brand palette with a single bright type colour

recipes.title: Dark phone macro tour with glowing name close
recipes.summary: Four tight macro shots of a dark phone (hero art, score rings, suggestion card, hero again) on hard cuts, the whole phone rises out of black, fades, then the name and a short tagline glow in on black.
use_when: A mobile app with one striking hero visual on its home screen
Premium, moody 9:16 teaser where the device is the set
An app whose home screen shows a score or a few ring metrics
Closing on name plus a 3-word tagline instead of a URL card

recipes.title: Dark tilted dashboard drift tour
recipes.summary: Seven close-ups of a dark dev-tool dashboard leaned back in steep perspective, each a single constant-speed drift in a new direction, lit by a soft spot that fades the plane into black; then a flat wordmark and mark.
use_when: A dense developer or analytics tool whose UI looks ordinary flat but expensive in depth
A silent product tour where staging, not copy, carries the film
Dark-themed products with one bright focal element per screen
A 30-40 s loopable showcase for a landing page hero or feed

recipes.title: Data chart shape morph
recipes.summary: A compact data card pulls back as a flat line becomes a moving area chart, then its six points reorganize into a radar plot. The chart earns its final form through one continuous transformation.
use_when: A metric story should progress from simple history to multidimensional comparison
A short silent data-visualization interlude needs one clear transformation
A dashboard feature needs motion without showing a full product screen

recipes.title: Desk laptop opener into a voiced editor step tutorial
recipes.summary: A filmed laptop on a dark desk shows a finished phone render, then the film becomes a screen capture on a blue backdrop that walks through each editor step under VO. One continuous shot, the result proves the steps.
use_when: A creative tool shows how fast a result is made, step by step, with VO
Vertical social tutorial where the finished output must open the film
A real screen recording exists and each step is one or two clicks
Showing that settings (zoom, tilt, animation, effects, export) change a preview live

recipes.title: Orbiting device with an interface dive
recipes.summary: A rendered phone turns through close and wide views while the camera travels across one interface, then dives into a detail and resolves to a quiet wordmark.
use_when: a mobile product needs a polished hero-object demo
one interface screen can support several camera framings
a silent product teaser needs continuous visual motion

recipes.title: Diagonal card staircase loop
recipes.summary: One hero image card shrinks into a pile of five, the pile fans out into a corner-to-corner diagonal and the view steps one card per second, then the cards slide back into one pile and the hero grows to fill the frame again: a seamless loop.
use_when: Showing four or five product shots, icons or renders as one calm sequence
A square feed loop for a minimal dev tool or SaaS brand
A gallery of feature visuals where each needs about one second of focus
Silent autoplay where no copy is needed beyond a small label block

recipes.title: Disc label to typed address, then a portfolio tour
recipes.summary: On flat grey a soft disc shrinks into a small icon over a one-line label, a tilted capsule flips flat into an address field that types itself, then three hard cuts tour the live pages: grid, hero with a sliding photo strip, item page.
use_when: Announcing a portfolio, shop or landing page where the address is the call to action
A short teaser that ends on real footage of the live pages
Creators or studios sharing a new personal page in under 8 s

recipes.title: Dots gather, unroll and morph into a wordmark
recipes.summary: Yellow dots pop in one by one on charcoal, huddle into a spinning cluster, unroll into a row of one dot per letter, then morph into a bold wordmark. A push-in flips it to an outline construction view and pans along the glyphs.
use_when: Opening a reel or intro with a short product name (3 to 6 letters)
A brand-name reveal that avoids a standard text entrance
Silent social loops where one accent colour on a dark ground carries the brand
Type-led brands that want to show their letterforms as craft

recipes.title: Dot-to-pill identity tag
recipes.summary: A white dot grows into a capsule on black, then a name fades in, an avatar slides in from the left and a verified seal pops on the right. Strict one-thing-per-beat phasing in 1.13 s; only the seal bounces.
use_when: A 3 s social sticker or lower-third that tags a person, account or product
Introducing a founder or creator before a longer clip
A loopable handle or name reveal for a feed post
Any moment where a small UI chip should read as switching on

recipes.title: Dot portal into a grain-wave brand reveal
recipes.summary: A one-word hook on cream whose letter dot opens into a dark scene with a drifting grainy green wave; short serif lines blur in, the mark grows, a dashboard pulls out to full view, then a typed URL and a mark hold close it.
use_when: A calm launch for a web app with one dashboard screenshot worth showing
Brand reveal where the mark and a two-tone name carry the middle of the film
A serif, premium voice with music only and no voice-over
Closing on a typed URL and a quiet mark hold

recipes.title: Duotone photo poster with a luminance flash
recipes.summary: A still aerial photo mapped to two greens holds under a two-line headline, a URL line and a round arrow button; once per loop a posterized light pass flares the highlights for about half a second, so the static poster reads as alive.
use_when: A vertical social ad or story built from one strong photo
A looping poster where nothing should move except a single accent
Brand colour has to own a stock or product photo
A silent autoplay placement with one headline and one link

recipes.title: Edge-on 3D button that tilts up to face the viewer
recipes.summary: A glossy extruded action button seen almost edge-on, its label skimming the top face, tilts toward the lens; the view then jumps wide and the button turns face-on and holds. One word, one object, curiosity then clarity.
use_when: Teasing a single action or feature that one button label can name
A short silent loop or social cut-down built around one verb
An opener before a UI demo that starts on the same button
Light, minimal brands where one tactile object carries the frame

recipes.title: Edge tab opens into a scrolling icon rail
recipes.summary: A small labelled tab grows out of a panel seam, morphs into a three-icon rail, and a hover dot drives it to scroll one item at a time up and back before it folds away. A loopable nav pattern demo.
use_when: Showing a compact side navigation or quick-switch rail in a web or desktop app
A loopable UI micro-demo for a landing page, docs or a social post
Explaining that a rail holds more items than it shows (scroll on hover)
A silent clip where one interaction pattern is the whole message

recipes.title: Vertical editor how-to with whip pans and a device turn
recipes.summary: A 27 s vertical tutorial: a laptop shows a video editor, the camera dives into its canvas and whip-pans between screenshot, inspector and timeline while a phone frame turns in 3D; two hard-cut extras, then mark and typed URL.
use_when: A creative or editing tool explains its whole workflow in under 30 s with voice-over
Vertical social feed (reels, shorts) where each VO step needs a matching UI moment
The product turns a flat screenshot into a framed, animated device shot
A how-to that should end on the mark and a typed URL

recipes.title: Elastic frame carousel
recipes.summary: Six stills cycle in a silent vertical loop. Each outgoing frame compresses toward the top edge while the next expands upward, turning every change into the subject.
use_when: A short silent reel needs motion from a set of still images
The scene changes should carry more energy than the individual frames
A looping editorial or product-image carousel needs one repeatable transition

recipes.title: Extruded phrase swing-in with push
recipes.summary: A short bold phrase swings in letter by letter with a solid cobalt side extrusion, lands over a soft orange blob backdrop, then the camera pushes in to the end. Faux depth gives a 3D title without a 3D scene.
use_when: A 3 s title or slogan sting for a playful consumer brand
Opening card of a promo where one short phrase is the whole message
Silent social loop where type has to carry energy without UI
Bumper before or after a longer film

recipes.title: Floating button fans into a stacked icon menu
recipes.summary: A round action button on a flat pale field drops down while three icon buttons pop out of it one by one into a centred vertical stack, hold, then snap back into the button, which springs home. Seamless 4 s loop.
use_when: Showing an expand-to-menu interaction in a mobile or web app demo
A looping micro-interaction clip for a landing page, docs or a feature card
Introducing quick actions or navigation shortcuts without any copy
A short silent insert between larger product shots

recipes.title: Centred feature list cascade
recipes.summary: Eleven short feature lines cascade in top to bottom on black, one every 1.5 frames, each fading up and rising a quarter line, then the full list holds still for three seconds so every item can be read.
use_when: The feature rundown section of a launch film, after the product reveal
A spec or capability list of 6-12 short items that should land as one block
Silent autoplay where a dense list has to read without VO
A calm, premium keynote voice with no UI to show

recipes.title: Hero word over a colour band, wiped on and off
recipes.summary: One frame-wide word with a white-to-blue fill rises over a glowing blue-violet-magenta band, then a short line, then a lit wordmark on black. Every element wipes on left to right, drifts left and is erased from the left.
use_when: A 4-5 s teaser or bumper: one verb, one promise line, the name
Opening a longer film with a single oversized word
Silent autoplay where three text beats must read without sound
A dark, premium brand with a cool gradient accent

recipes.title: Fixed mark over a flickering image montage
recipes.summary: The brand mark holds dead centre while full-frame images swap under it every 2-6 frames, a 1 s loop of six looks run four times; mid-film the mark flips dark to light. A still mark over chaos is all the eye can hold.
use_when: A 3-5 s logo sting or bumper for a brand with a strong single mark
Showing the mark works on any background: photo, colour, light and dark
Silent loops for social feeds or event screens
Teasing a visual identity system (palette, imagery, device use) in one shot

recipes.title: Focus drum word stepper
recipes.summary: A tilted column of single words on black steps up one line every 0.75 s. Only the word at the arrow is sharp and white; neighbours fall off into grey blur, so the eye locks on one word at a time and the list reads as momentum.
use_when: Title or chapter intro listing 6-12 qualities or themes, one word each
Silent loop for a hero banner or social header
Opener before a product statement, naming what the product is about
Editorial or portfolio reels where type is the whole picture

recipes.title: Fog clears on a night forest, a site screen rises
recipes.summary: One continuous shot: the camera pushes through dense night fog and thorny branches until a dark website screen, lying in the grass, tilts upright and settles centre frame under a moonlit sky.
use_when: a seasonal or themed teaser where the setting sells the mood and the landing page is the payoff
a single hero page to show with no feature walk-through
silent autoplay loops on social where one slow reveal is enough

recipes.title: Iridescent foil sheen on a still mark
recipes.summary: A single brand mark holds dead centre on black while a pearly, iridescent foil sheen drifts across its surface. Nothing moves but the light, so the mark reads as a premium physical object.
use_when: A premium end card or logo sting of about 3 s
A brand with a bold, solid mark that can carry a surface texture
Silent loops for social headers or product pages
Closing a longer film where the mark should feel tangible, not animated

recipes.title: Laptop in a forest plate, whip in and out
recipes.summary: A laptop showing one landing page sits in a sunlit forest behind ferns. The camera whips in, drifts left for 3 s, whips out past a tree trunk, and the 5 s cycle runs twice. The page reads as a calm object in nature.
use_when: A brand with an outdoor, natural or wellness voice shows its landing page
A silent 10 s social loop around one hero screenshot
You have one strong page screenshot and no UI animation to show
An opener before a longer product walkthrough

recipes.title: Frosted glass digit clock tick
recipes.summary: Four giant frosted glass digits in a two-row clock layout over a soft blurred colour field; the last digit steps once per second. Refraction through the glyphs makes a static frame feel premium and alive.
use_when: A countdown or timer moment before a launch or deadline
A premium, calm loop for a social post or a hero background
A stat beat where one number ticks up in whole steps
A silent autoplay tile with no copy beyond the number

recipes.title: Frosted quote card over a pulled-back photo
recipes.summary: A blurred glass card shrinks into place while a warm lifestyle photo pulls back behind it, then a customer quote writes in word by word, the attribution fades up and a heart lights. One calm, readable proof shot.
use_when: A single customer quote as the social-proof beat of a launch film
Silent feed posts where one testimonial must read in under 3 s
You have a warm lifestyle or customer photo and no product UI to show
Looping card for a site hero or testimonial carousel slot

recipes.title: Liquid glass capsule squash and stretch
recipes.summary: One refractive glass shape over a dark red striped shader: a wide capsule squeezes into a small circle, swells into a large lens, then stretches into a thin full-width bar. Spring overshoot on every change makes the glass feel elastic.
use_when: Showing off a glass material or a liquid-glass UI style with no copy
A loopable ambient background or interstitial between product shots
Teasing a control (button, search bar, toggle) before its UI appears
A dark, single-accent brand that wants motion without type

recipes.title: Glass puzzle cube twisting on neon rails
recipes.summary: A dark 3x3x3 glass puzzle cube with blue liquid inside rests on diagonal glowing rails, turns single layers, then tumbles and fans its columns apart before re-forming. A wordless hero-object loop for a premium dark brand.
use_when: A wordless hero loop or background plate behind a headline
A dark, blue-accented brand that wants a premium 3D object moment
Visualising assembly, modularity or solving a puzzle without copy
Opening bed under a title card added later

recipes.title: Glass icon tumble relay over ribbon waves
recipes.summary: Three thick glass app tiles with white line glyphs tumble in one after another over a pastel iridescent ribbon field, settle centre, float, and hand over to the next. One locked shot, no copy: the material is the message.
use_when: Showing three features or app sections as icons, no UI needed
A premium, calm silent loop for a landing hero or social post
Opening an app announcement before the product UI appears
Brands with a light, glossy, glass-heavy visual language

recipes.title: Glass mark macro orbit, light-on and dive
recipes.summary: Macro glimpses of a blue glass mark, then a thin glowing slab drifting through black; it turns face-on, goes dark, lights up with a wide halo, the camera dives through it into a glowing wordmark and a tagline.
use_when: A logo teaser or brand intro where the mark itself is the story
A dark, cinematic opener before a launch film
A brand with a simple geometric mark that reads as an extruded solid
A silent autoplay piece that needs suspense before the name

recipes.title: Glass slider, petal icon and tinted pane fan
recipes.summary: A refractive glass track slides under a fixed call knob over deep blue waves, a hard cut to a pastel petal icon pulling out and turning, then one lilac glass pane splits into a three-pane fan that rotates and merges back.
use_when: Showing off a translucent glass material or a new visual style for a UI kit
A short silent loop for a feed where the material is the message
Teasing a call, unlock or confirm control before the full product film
An app icon refresh where the icon itself can carry a shot

recipes.title: Glossy block tumble with camera push-in
recipes.summary: Five glossy rounded primitives on a dark gradient floor: a block tumbles in from the right, bumps the hero cube and settles, then the camera springs in to a low close-up and holds. A brand-colour toy moment with no copy.
use_when: A short abstract brand sting built from the brand palette as physical objects
An intro or bumper before a title card, where weight and contact read as playful
Social loops or teasers that need motion without any copy or UI

recipes.title: Blue-lit prompt-to-site build tour
recipes.summary: A glowing pixel types a promise and becomes a button; a prompt is sent, a browser page assembles and is light-scanned, action pills pop, a ring dollies open on a claim, tool tiles orbit, the mark glitches in. One blue light ties it.
use_when: An AI builder or generator product that turns a prompt into a page, app or document
A dark, single-accent brand where everything can be lit by one colour
A 30 s site hero or launch teaser that walks prompt, result, workflow, integrations, logo
Showing integrations as a tool-tile carousel after the main feature

recipes.title: Glowing search icon pulls out to a panel, button flips in
recipes.summary: One dark shot: a red-haloed search icon pulls out to reveal it sits in a sidebar header with a red rim light, the panel dims away, then a glowing button turns from edge-on to face the camera.
use_when: A short teaser for one UI action (search, share, export) on a dark brand
Intro or social loop where a single icon and one button carry the story
Brands with a strong saturated accent that can be the light source
Silent autoplay where light and one camera move replace copy

recipes.title: Glowing map tile with route dive
recipes.summary: A rim-lit map tile grows out of dark space, a route draws across it, the camera dives to a nav arrow and follows it past three bold street labels, then pulls back to the whole tile. One continuous shot, no copy.
use_when: A navigation, delivery, travel or location product with a route as its core idea
A short teaser where one continuous camera move replaces cuts and copy
Dark premium brands that want a glow object instead of a screenshot
Opening a longer film with the product map before feature beats

recipes.title: Gradient spec line word drop
recipes.summary: One short spec line on white, each word dropping from slightly above while fading in, staggered about a quarter second apart, the whole line painted in a cool-to-lime gradient, then a long calm hold.
use_when: A chapter title or single feature claim inside a premium announcement
Naming one hero spec (resolution, battery, speed) in three words or fewer
Opening a silent product reel on a light, restrained brand
Inserting a calm text beat between UI or device shots

recipes.title: Guide lines close on a dot that punches into a ring
recipes.summary: Four hairline guides slide in from the frame edges and box a gradient dot as it grows; the dot dips, a hole punches open and it swells into a ring, then the ring thins away as the guides fly back out. A 3 s loopable mark sting.
use_when: A short loopable sting for a round or ring-shaped mark
A light, design-tool or precision-themed brand that wants a construction-grid feel
A bumper before or after a longer film, no copy needed
A gradient brand colour that should carry the moment on white

recipes.title: Product hero with cascading key callouts
recipes.summary: A flat hardware hero scales up from small and fades in on white, settles, then four thin leader-line callouts with short labels and outlined targets appear one after another. A quiet spec-sheet beat that points at details.
use_when: A hardware or device product where specific buttons, ports or keys deserve a name
A spec-sheet beat inside a longer launch film, after the hero shot
A silent loop for a product page that labels 3-5 details
Clean light keynote look with no camera moves or cuts

recipes.title: Horizon arc into prompt bar and generated image
recipes.summary: A mark on black, then a lit planet rim rises under it and folds into a glowing prompt bar. A request is typed, a cursor sends it, the result grows out of the send button to full bleed, and a wipe returns to the mark.
use_when: An AI tool that turns a typed prompt into a visual result (image, design, video)
A short launch teaser where the brand moment and the product moment share one shot
Dark, premium brands with one accent colour that can carry a glow
Silent autoplay: the typed prompt explains the product without VO

recipes.title: Horizon glow claims, photo fly-through and podium
recipes.summary: A 60 s voice-led pitch on black with a blue horizon glow: phone peek, one-word claims, a fly-through wall of frustrated photo tiles, then one feature per beat (button press, card grid, podium count, tilted phone) and a typed URL lockup.
use_when: A 60 s voice-over explainer for a marketplace, wallet or payments app
The story needs a clear pain beat before the product appears
Several features, each one short line plus one visual, no footage
Dark brand with one cool accent colour that can carry a horizon glow

recipes.title: Hover card stack expand loop
recipes.summary: A single content card waits on a soft grey gradient; the pointer reaches it, a count badge appears and a second card slides out from behind, holds, then tucks back. One component, one interaction, a seamless loop.
use_when: Showing one interactive component state (hover, expand) for a design system or UI kit
A short looping clip for a landing page section or social post about a component
Explaining a stacked notification or recent-items widget in under 6 s
Silent autoplay where a single gesture has to read without copy

recipes.title: Icon dive into a tilted dashboard tour
recipes.summary: A three-line offer rises over a dark backdrop with a blue rim, an app-icon tile drops in and the camera dives through it, then seven light UI screens glide past on tilted planes under blue light for 30 s, each one held about 4 s.
use_when: A business or back-office product with many dense screens and no single hero moment
A silent premium showcase for a site header, sales deck or social feed
You have 5-7 clean screens and want each one readable for about 4 s
The offer (demo, trial) should open the film instead of closing it

recipes.title: Self-intro card: name, role slot, shape cover
recipes.summary: A tiny greeting and name on light grey, a shape that slides in and swells to cover the frame, one huge bold word that shrinks to line size on blue, a role word that rolls through four titles, then a social handle.
use_when: a personal or freelancer intro for a portfolio, profile or reel opener
an 8 s card that lists several roles or services in one slot
a calm, type-only opener with one colour flip in the middle

recipes.title: Island pill opens into a live trip card
recipes.summary: A small top pill on a translucent phone over a soft sky widens, adds a middle label, then springs open into a dark status card where a hero image slides in, clouds drift past and a progress bar creeps; it folds back to the pill and loops.
use_when: Showing a live status widget (trip, delivery, order) on a phone
A vertical loop for a feed or a landing page hero
Demonstrating real-time progress without a cut
One calm UI moment with no VO and no music

recipes.title: Beat-Built Phrase Into a Glass UI
recipes.summary: A centred phrase grows one word at a time, sheds its earlier words, and dives into a glass badge. A floating orb carries the focus into a compact interface reveal.
use_when: a six-to-eight-second feature teaser led by typography
a launch beat that must bridge copy into one compact interface
a light brand with one saturated accent and translucent surfaces

recipes.title: Kinetic type move reel on light grey
recipes.summary: Eleven text beats on flat light grey, one type move each: lens pull, centred re-flow, spring rise, four gradient verbs rising through a clip mask, a typed URL. Exits have direction and beat entrances.
use_when: A type-only launch or capability list with no UI to show yet
Listing four one-word verbs of what the product does
A silent autoplay feed where type alone must carry 15 s
Showing off a range of text animation styles in one film

recipes.title: Landing page blocks with arcing hero letters
recipes.summary: A rebuilt landing page fades up on a pale backdrop; the headline rises out of line masks, block copy and avatars cascade in, and one word's letters swing along an arc into a vertical stack beside the hero photo. Holds, then fades out.
use_when: Showing a website or landing page design as a short silent loop
A studio or agency portfolio post where one page layout is the subject
Opening a site launch film on the hero section before a scroll tour
Social cutdowns that need one calm 5 s product moment

recipes.title: Laptop dock push into a glowing toolbar tour
recipes.summary: A lit laptop pushes in on one hopping dock tile and match-cuts to the mark; a glowing pill toolbar, word-by-word claims on black and drag-to-select grabs that drop into an editor canvas sell a screen-grab tool.
use_when: A screen or screen-grab tool whose UI is a small floating toolbar
A desktop utility launched from a dock or menu bar
Showing grabs becoming editable layers in a second app
Silent social cut where short black statements carry the pitch

recipes.title: Dark laptop orbit to phone list, wordmark close
recipes.summary: A dark laptop with a market dashboard: the camera swoops from a wide 3/4 view into the charts, pulls back, drops to a phone with an earnings list, glides down it under a rim glint, then a lit wordmark holds.
use_when: A finance or analytics product with a desktop dashboard and a mobile companion
Showing the same product on two devices in one continuous camera move
A silent, premium dark teaser of 10 to 15 s
You have two screenshots and a wordmark, no copy lines

recipes.title: Leaned website sections, cut tour to a URL card
recipes.summary: A vertical tour of one website: four page sections on a leaned 3D plane, each a slow camera move of 3-4 s joined by hard cuts, closing on a small serif URL on black. Depth and drift make a static site feel filmed.
use_when: A studio, agency or freelancer shows off a site it built, vertical feed
A landing page with a hero, a services block, a form and contact details
Silent autoplay where the UI itself has to carry the film
A short portfolio piece that must end on the URL

recipes.title: Letter echo trail drop and rise loop
recipes.summary: One short uppercase word on a flat saturated field drops from the top edge to the bottom and rises back, letter by letter in a left-to-right wave; each letter drags a stack of fading echoes behind it. Seamless loop.
use_when: A loopable social or banner accent where one word is the whole picture
A high-energy sting between scenes of a longer film
A product name or one-word claim that needs motion without any UI
Square or vertical feeds that autoplay silently

recipes.title: Letter rise with recentring slide
recipes.summary: One bold oblique word builds letter by letter: each letter rises and fades in on a 1.5 fr stagger while the whole word slides left into centre, holds about one second, then smears out in 4 frames.
use_when: A section header or chapter title inside a longer film
Revealing a product name or one-word claim on a flat background
A short looping title sting for social or a site hero
Type-only openers where one word must feel deliberate

recipes.title: Line icon morph chain into a loader
recipes.summary: One centred line icon on a flat warm colour turns into the next every 1-2 s: bag, plane, window, globe, pin, then it collapses to a dash that fans into a spinning loader and vanishes. One stroke weight ties the chain into a single journey.
use_when: Linking 4-6 feature or journey steps with one icon each, no copy needed
A short looping explainer for an icon set or a step-by-step flow
A transition sting between scenes of a longer film
Ending on a loading or processing state before a result

recipes.title: Wordmark line morphs into a phone with a listening orb
recipes.summary: A two-bar mark shrinks and unfolds into a wordmark, a line splits it and widens into a white phone; a reading screen with word highlights gives way to an assistant screen with a big gradient orb, then a quiet closing line.
use_when: A mobile reading, listening or voice-assistant app with two hero screens
One continuous shot from logo to product, no cuts, silent autoplay
A soft pastel brand that wants calm, premium motion instead of fast cutting
Showing an AI or voice mode as an orb rather than a chat thread

recipes.title: Three-line headline that springs in on a tilt and swings out
recipes.summary: A stacked three-line headline grows in line by line from a small, slightly rotated state, overshoots and snaps level, holds, then swells and swings clockwise before collapsing back. A short punchy loop for one bold message.
use_when: A single bold three-beat message for an editorial or promo post
A silent looping social tile in 4:5 with a header mark and a CTA pill
The hook of a longer film where one headline must hit in under 1 s
Brands with a loud display grotesk and a two-colour palette

recipes.title: Lock screen notifications landing from the camera
recipes.summary: A phone drops into a dark frame lit by a blue planet rim, settles on its lock screen, then two glass notifications arrive one at a time: the first lands from the viewer, the second takes the top slot after a push-down.
use_when: A mobile product whose value is a timely alert or message
Showing what the user receives, one event at a time, fully readable
A short silent loop for a feed or a landing-page hero
Opening shot before a longer app walkthrough

recipes.title: Lockup with a stepping word wheel
recipes.summary: A fixed logo lockup sits beside a tall vertical list of one-word features; the list steps up one slot per second and only the word level with the lockup is dark. Twenty steps make a seamless 20 s loop.
use_when: A product with many features or product lines that each fit in one word
A looping brand background for a booth screen, story or site hero
A calm, confident fintech or utility brand voice with no UI to show
Silent autoplay where the lockup must stay readable the whole time

recipes.title: Tap-driven mark with palette wipes
recipes.summary: A centered mark contracts like a press, then rebounds as a rounded field expands to the next palette color. Five evenly spaced changes and a matched loop make a compact, tactile brand intro.
use_when: A brand mark and a five-color palette are the whole story
A square silent loop needs an interaction-like rhythm
A short brand intro should feel tactile without showing a cursor

recipes.title: Low-angle laptop editor tour with agent-made edits
recipes.summary: A laptop shot from keyboard level shows a motion editor flipping through sample scenes on every cut, then the camera dives into the UI to watch prompts, retyped labels, icon picks and an export dialog play out under VO.
use_when: a vertical 45-60 s explainer for a creative tool or editor
showing an AI agent or integration driving a real app UI
a social cut where VO carries the story and the UI proves it
products with many sample outputs to flip through in the hook

recipes.title: Close-up mark pan, snap out to lockup
recipes.summary: The camera starts so close that the brand mark fills the frame, travels across it while the wordmark wipes in, then snaps out in one frame to the small centred lockup, holds and fades. The hidden scale makes a tiny logo feel big.
use_when: A 4 s logo sting or the close of a longer film
A brand with a simple geometric mark next to a one-word name
Silent social loops where a flat colour field has to carry the brand
An intro bumper before a product demo

recipes.title: Macro phone study-app tour, scan to quiz
recipes.summary: A dark phone UI shot in shallow-focus macro on tilted planes: home, new topic, scan pages, a topic card counting up, step trail, reading screen, mascot and a quiz answered. Black tagline and wordmark close.
use_when: A mobile app with a clear multi-step flow (create, capture, learn, test) to walk through in 30 s
Dark product UI that looks premium when lit like a physical object in macro
An app with a mascot or character that can carry an emotional beat mid-film
Store launch where the close is mark, wordmark and store badges

recipes.title: Magnetic pill button with a pointer light
recipes.summary: One violet pill button on deep indigo. The cursor arrives, the pill swells about 1.45x and leans toward it, a soft inner light follows the pointer, then a press shrinks and whitens it and it settles back to rest. Loops.
use_when: The CTA beat of an end card: one button, one action
A web demo or landing hero that needs a hover micro-interaction
A short seamless loop for a social post or a docs header
Showing that a product's UI reacts to the pointer

recipes.title: Mark handoff into a connector chat tour
recipes.summary: Two-brand lockup opens, then one continuous dark UI tour: add a connector, three prompts with streamed answers, an authorize click that morphs into a permissions list, and the mark returns as the end card.
use_when: Announcing an integration that plugs one product into an AI assistant
Showing a setup flow end to end: install, ask, act, grant permissions
A calm dark product walkthrough with no cuts and no VO
Partnership launches where both marks share the opening lockup

recipes.title: Mark grows from a dot, slides open a phrase, hides it
recipes.summary: On black, a glowing mark grows from a dot at centre, glides left, then whips right and drags a short phrase out from behind its edge. It slides back over the phrase to swallow it and settles left, dimmed. One object does every move.
use_when: A 4 s logo sting or bumper with a mark and one short line
Opening or closing a dark film with the brand mark as the only actor
A mark with a strong silhouette that reads at 10 % of frame width
Silent autoplay where one motion idea must carry the brand

recipes.title: Dark viewer card cycling marks with blur swaps
recipes.summary: One dark rounded card on flat light grey lights up a mark, then swaps it for the next every 1.5 s: the old mark slides left into blur, the new one sharpens in from the right, its name wipes in below. Loops back to empty.
use_when: Showing an integrations, partners or product-family row one mark at a time
A silent loop for a landing page hero or social card about a logo set
Before/after of a mark evolution, one state per slot
Any 4:5 or 1:1 post where a calm, repeatable rhythm beats a full film

recipes.title: Twin serif phrases around a splitting wordmark
recipes.summary: Two 2-line serif phrases rise out of clip masks above and below a small centred wordmark; the mark splits in half and pushes the phrases apart, then the top phrase drops away and the bottom one holds alone.
use_when: A fashion, beauty or lifestyle brand opening a campaign with a two-part contrast line
Silent autoplay feeds where type alone carries a short editorial statement
A 6 s intro or bumper in 4:5 before product shots
Brands with a short all-caps wordmark that reads when split into two halves

recipes.title: Masked field retries, then a calm word rise
recipes.summary: A lone password field is typed, wiped and retyped three times, each attempt longer, before one still line names the pain. The product then fills the field in one go and three short lines rise word by word to a URL.
use_when: Security, login or credential products whose pain is a familiar input struggle
Problem then solution story told with behaviour before any copy
Silent autoplay where a tiny UI moment carries the hook
Short 15-20 s teaser with one UI element rebuilt in React

recipes.title: Menu slot roll into a drifting image wall
recipes.summary: A one-line claim types in on pale grey, a sidebar menu rolls entry by entry like a slot drum, spins and lands on one entry, the camera pushes into it, a three-column image wall drifts up, and one card grows into a dimmed closing frame.
use_when: A tool or library with a long feature list where one category is the differentiator
A 15 to 20 s vertical reel narrated by VO, one claim per beat
The product owns a strong image set that can carry the second half
Moving from a calm light UI opening to a moody full-bleed close

recipes.title: Metric card with sliding highlight and chart swap
recipes.summary: One light dashboard card settles in while its line chart draws on and two figures roll up; a lime highlight then slides to the second tile and the chart wipes over to that metric's series before the card folds away.
use_when: Showing one growth metric and a second related figure in a 5 s loop
Investor or launch slide where a single chart proves a claim
Silent feed or website hero loop for a data or analytics product
Comparing two series that share one axis without cutting

recipes.title: Milestone number rolls up one step at a time
recipes.summary: A big accent-coloured number on white ticks up one unit at a time, each digit rolling upward through a clip, then cascades into the round milestone while a short label rises in below. Built-in suspense, one clear figure.
use_when: Announcing a round milestone (users, downloads, stars)
A short silent social post where one number is the whole message
A stat insert inside a longer launch film
A growth update that should feel earned, not shouted

recipes.title: Orbiting phone close-up with a quiet brand finish
recipes.summary: A vivid phone fills the frame through three continuous 3D passes, then settles beside a short product line before collapsing to a mark and a restrained closing credit.
use_when: a phone app needs a cinematic hero teaser
one product screen and one numeric proof point can carry the story
a short launch bumper needs a mark-led finish

recipes.title: Modular card grid that reflows in a loop
recipes.summary: Dark rounded cards in a fixed panel re-tile three times: columns slide, then rows, then columns, each move landing on a new layout and the last back on the first. Short holds let each set read.
use_when: Showing 6 to 8 pieces of work, features or screens at once without cuts
A looping hero or background clip for a site, a deck or a feed
A studio or product overview where the layout itself is the motion
Silent autoplay where no copy has to carry the message

recipes.title: Multiplayer cursor mockup collage
recipes.summary: A one-word-at-a-time sentence on white while named cursor tags draw frames that fill with device mockups; the collage collapses to a sphere, a dark mark beat, staged phone shots, a gallery that scatters and stacks, then a quiet end card.
use_when: A design or mockup tool that wants to show many polished outputs in 30 s
Products with real-time collaboration where named cursors are part of the story
A silent autoplay launch on a light canvas with one dark brand interlude
You have 10 or more finished renders or screenshots to show as a gallery

recipes.title: Neon search bar to answer, compare and lockup
recipes.summary: A search bar glows green on black with light streaks, a question pill lands, dots think, a step-by-step answer card fills in, a two-panel us-vs-them compare holds, then a glowing wordmark, tagline and button close. One shot, 8 s.
use_when: Showing an AI assistant answering one developer question end to end
A short silent teaser for a chatbot or docs assistant on a dark, neon brand
Closing a product tour with a quick ours-vs-others comparison and a start button

recipes.title: Neon tube macro triptych
recipes.summary: Three hard-cut macro views of one glowing tube on black: a bent corner, a level band with light sliding along it, a forked joint. A slow creep keeps each hold alive; a vertical mood loop or backdrop for type.
use_when: A vertical teaser or story background before the product or a line of type appears
Brands with a single saturated accent colour that can carry a whole frame
Silent autoplay openers where a 6 s abstract hold is enough
A backplate behind a short statement or logo added on top

recipes.title: Offset panel share breakdown rise
recipes.summary: A small chart title holds alone on charcoal, then five offset colour panels rise from a baseline one after another, pushing the title to the top while each panel's percentage rolls up from zero. A silent 4 s share reveal.
use_when: Showing how one total splits into 3 to 6 parts (revenue, usage, audience)
A vertical social post or story slide with one data reveal
A proof beat inside a longer film where a breakdown backs a claim
Silent autoplay where the numbers must carry the message

recipes.title: Voice assistant orb with status card tour
recipes.summary: On a bright grid canvas a tiny call glyph grows into an app icon, a brand moment plays on a soft gradient, then a glossy orb speaks in typed lines and three rim-lit cards land one by one while the camera follows the newest.
use_when: Launching a voice or chat agent that does a few concrete jobs for the user
Showing three capabilities as live status cards rather than screen recordings
A calm, light, premium tone with no music or VO required
A 20 to 25 s explainer where the assistant itself is the character

recipes.title: Scrolling page card with typed address
recipes.summary: A chrome-less landing page on a rounded card scrolls up and out, the domain types itself in the gap, then a dark section drops in, scrolls, and the page whips back to its hero so the last frame matches the first.
use_when: Showing off a finished marketing page or portfolio site in a short silent loop
Agency reels and client handovers where the page design is the product
A launch post that needs the domain on screen without an end card
Feeds that autoplay on loop: the last frame returns to the first

recipes.title: Collectible card swaying in perspective
recipes.summary: One portrait card on black leans into perspective to one side, holds, returns flat, then leans the other way and returns. Inner art layers slide against the frame, so a flat image reads as a thick object.
use_when: Showcasing a single collectible, pass, ticket or membership card
A loopable hero or social post for a digital item with one artwork
Giving a flat product shot depth without a 3D model
A calm, silent autoplay loop on a dark page

recipes.title: Dot-grid figures reach for a glowing mark, then type
recipes.summary: A glowing app mark spins in on black while two dot-column figures slide in from the edges and reach for it; the scene loses its light, an offer line and a grey sub-line blur in, then a URL is typed on a silent black end.
use_when: a short silent teaser for a service or agency offer with a single promise
opening a film with a premium mark moment before any UI exists
a dark brand with a strong single-colour icon (blue, cyan, violet)
muted autoplay feeds where the copy must carry the offer

recipes.title: Floating letter toss partner lockup
recipes.summary: Two partner names, each as oversized single letters tossed up from below and drifting in slow rotation, joined by a spinning cross on a colour flip. Weightless letter motion makes a plain name pairing playful.
use_when: Announcing a partnership or collab: name, cross, name
A short silent title card where the type itself is the entertainment
Social loops and story openers under 3 s
Brands with a short name of 4 to 7 letters

recipes.title: Laptop on a sky peak with a cloud wipe
recipes.summary: Clouds part as the camera rises to a laptop balanced on a rocky summit in a blue sky. The laptop lifts off, tilts toward camera and fills the frame, then drops away and clouds sweep back in, so the short clip loops.
use_when: A web product hero shot where one landing screen is the whole message
A short silent loop for a site header, social feed or ad slot
Brands with an airy, sky or lightness theme
Opening a longer film with a device reveal before the feature tour

recipes.title: Phone call pill and queued notification stack
recipes.summary: A phone swings in, the camera snaps to its top where a dark call pill materialises, then tilts down as light cards rise from a visible depth queue and a dark missed-call card fades in. Dark-on-pastel contrast sets hierarchy.
use_when: A messaging, calling or CRM app whose value is the stream of incoming events
Showing that a product catches calls and messages the user would otherwise miss
A short silent loop for a landing page hero or a social feed
Phone-first products with no desktop UI to show

recipes.title: Phone close-up whip tour with tagline swap
recipes.summary: One phone on a bright two-tone gradient: it rises in, then the camera punches, tilts and whips across its home screen in tight close-ups. It ends wide with a tagline the phone itself wipes into the call to action.
use_when: A mobile app with one strong home screen worth touring up close
Silent social autoplay where motion, not VO, carries the energy
A short app teaser that ends on a tagline plus a try-it line
Brands with a loud single accent colour that can fill the background

recipes.title: Device fan-out to in-app checkout
recipes.summary: One phone on black, then three back-view colour variants slide out beside it under a name pill; a price and pay button appear, a cursor clicks, and the film dives into a store app: add to bag, bag page, face-scan confirm.
use_when: Hardware or accessory launch that ends in a buy action
Showing colour or finish variants side by side before a purchase flow
Store or checkout app demo that wants a product-shot opener
Silent autoplay ad on a dark feed

recipes.title: Phone screens fan out from one
recipes.summary: One numbered phone screen holds centre, then four more slide out from behind it into a symmetric fan while the group eases back to 91 %. A 1.3 s reveal of several app screens that then holds still as a poster.
use_when: Showing that an app has several screens or steps in one short shot
A silent opener or loop tile for an app launch post
Intro beat before a longer phone feature tour
Placeholder layout to drop real screenshots into, numbered by order

recipes.title: Phone screen that assembles from the lens
recipes.summary: An empty phone on flat grey fills itself group by group: header, three action tiles, a section label, five list rows and a tab bar each fall from the camera, big and blurred, onto their slots with overlapping staggers.
use_when: A mobile app whose home screen is a list of items (projects, devices, accounts)
A 5 s silent loop or opener before a feature tour
Showing that an app is set up instantly or that a workspace fills itself
A light, calm product voice where depth comes from motion, not 3D

recipes.title: Macro phone screen glide with a hero pull-back
recipes.summary: Four equal close-ups glide across one phone home screen in a dark blue void with shallow focus, each on one region (header, actions, balance, tab bar), then the whole device rises into a centred hold. Quiet, premium, one screen is enough.
use_when: A mobile app with one strong home screen and no story to tell yet
Silent loop or background reel for a fintech or consumer app page
A premium, calm product teaser with no copy and no VO
Opening a longer film with a tactile look at the UI before features

recipes.title: Phone macro glide, twin phones, icon to wordmark
recipes.summary: One phone rises to fill a flat acid-lime frame, then the camera glides in macro over its balance chart and tab bar, slides up the screen on a tilted low angle, pulls back to two phones, and closes on the app icon and a lowercase wordmark.
use_when: A mobile finance or tracking app with one strong home screen (balance + chart + tab bar)
Silent social or landing-page loop where the product UI is the whole story
A loud single-colour brand background that can carry the frame without type
Teaser before launch: no copy lines, only the screen, the icon and the name

recipes.title: Orbit-to-phone feature journey
recipes.summary: A dark statement opens into a glowing selector, expanding rings cycle three benefit words, then a framed phone carries the viewer through a feed, chart and configurable list before a quiet logo hold.
use_when: a 20-30 s launch film with three connected mobile features
a dark product reveal that needs a visual bridge from promise to UI
a phone-first release with a proof chart and configurable list
a silent autoplay film where motion must explain the sequence

recipes.title: Tilted phone page scroll with a twin-locale pair
recipes.summary: A realistic phone rises out of black and tilts while a mobile landing page scrolls on its screen; a low-angle pass over the article list, then two phones (two languages) cycle cards in sync before a logo, tagline and URL end card.
use_when: Showing that a marketing site or web app works on mobile, top to bottom
A vertical feed film for an agency or service business with no product UI beyond its pages
Proving a second language or right-to-left version ships with the same layout
Silent autoplay where the scrolling page carries the story

recipes.title: Phone roll and flip into a desktop card
recipes.summary: A tall phone screen rolls a quarter turn with its tiled backdrop, flips over like a card and lands as a wide desktop screen while the camera pushes in. One continuous move says the product works on both.
use_when: Announcing that a mobile product now has a desktop or web version
A 5 s cross-platform beat inside a longer launch film
You have one mobile and one desktop screenshot and no motion footage
A light, calm, silent loop for a landing page or feed

recipes.title: Phone screen row that steps one card per beat
recipes.summary: A row of tall phone-screen cards on a light-to-grey floor glides left one card pitch about every 2.15 s: a fast eased slide, then a slow creep. One continuous move tours many screens with no cuts.
use_when: Touring 6-10 mobile app screens in one silent loop
A product page hero or social loop where screenshots carry the message
A feature-tour beat inside a longer mobile launch film
A calm, minimal brand voice with no VO and no SFX

recipes.title: Spinning phone swaps sides with each line
recipes.summary: A phone spins in from the right and parks on the left beside a one-line statement, then turns once more and crosses to the right while a two-line claim wipes in on the left. Each line is wiped in the direction the phone travels.
use_when: A mobile site or app needs a 5 s teaser with two short lines and one hero screen
Silent social autoplay where one screenshot and two lines carry the message
A looping hero loop on a light landing page (starts and ends on blank white)
Setup line then benefit line, each paired with the same device

recipes.title: Spinning phone sweeps two statements
recipes.summary: On white, a phone showing a call screen spins a full turn while it crosses the frame; its pass wipes one short line away and draws the next in behind it. Two lines, two sweeps, the phone grows each time, then a clean exit to white.
use_when: A phone-first product with one hero screen and a two-line setup and promise
A 5 s silent social loop or an opener before a longer app film
Pairing a situation line with the product's answer to it
Light, minimal brands where the device itself is the motion

recipes.title: Dark phone tumble with split claims
recipes.summary: On black, a dark phone tumbles from its back to its screen side every 4 s and settles as a diagonal screen close-up; each claim splits into two halves flanking it. One continuous shot, seven turns, quiet premium rhythm.
use_when: A mobile app promo with no UI ready to show yet
A dark, premium hardware-feel teaser with four to six short claims
Silent autoplay where each claim gets a full 4 s hold
A trailer that should feel like one camera move, not a montage

recipes.title: Phone header snap-zoom into a bills list
recipes.summary: A blue phone card materialises on white, the camera snaps into its greeting header and pans across it, whips away, then a bills list with filter chips builds and the camera dives onto one row's status pill before fading to white.
use_when: A mobile finance or billing app with a personal home header and a list screen
A short silent loop for a landing page hero or social post
Showing two screens of a phone app at detail zoom without a full device shot
A light, clean brand where one saturated colour carries the app

recipes.title: Parallax photo plate with a URL letter rise
recipes.summary: A black plate on a flat colour field fades a photo up inside an inset mask while the plate shrinks faster than the picture; a bold URL rises letter by letter across it, then the photo window collapses to a corner and the letters sink away.
use_when: A short loop that pairs one hero photo with a web address
Editorial or portfolio sites that want depth without 3D
A closing card where the URL is the only copy
Silent social autoplay that must loop seamlessly

recipes.title: Photo ring spin and column dive
recipes.summary: Portrait photos float on true black in 3D: first a ring of cards turns past the camera, then a hard cut drops into a deep column of cards. Each shot is one eased in-out move, so the parallax reads like a real camera.
use_when: A gallery, portfolio or image product that needs its pictures to carry the frame
An interlude or opener between scenes of a longer film
Silent autoplay where bright imagery on black has to hold attention
A looping background for a landing page hero

recipes.title: Pill button splits into an icon trio
recipes.summary: A single labelled pill button dims its label, then breaks into three round chips (payment, cart, item count) and later merges back. One flat light shot, no cuts, a seamless loop for a micro-interaction demo.
use_when: Showing a button that expands into quick actions or a status count
An e-commerce or checkout micro-interaction clip, silent and loopable
A short UI detail insert inside a longer product film
A landing-page hero loop for a component or design-system release

recipes.title: Pin tile into a tilted dark panel tour
recipes.summary: A warning card on a tilted plane yields to a white pin that settles into an app tile; glowing pills draw in, tilted UI panels pass under rack focus, then a two-line close and a flat wordmark.
use_when: A privacy, security or utility product whose story is: you are exposed, here is the switch
Silent autoplay launch where dark tilted UI and soft glow carry the premium feel
A small UI with 3-5 distinct panels that read well leaned back in 3D
The app icon is a strong single glyph that can stand alone for 4 s

recipes.title: Pixel cursor block build and erode
recipes.summary: A blocky arrow pointer grows from its tip one diagonal of square cells at a time, holds for a third of a second, then erodes from the edges into one cell and vanishes. Stepped 10 fps timing reads as crafted pixel art.
use_when: A screen-demo film needs a custom pointer entrance before the cursor starts moving
Opening or closing beat for a pixel, retro or developer-tool brand
A 2 s loopable sticker or avatar loop on a flat background
A transition sting between UI demo shots where the pointer is the subject

recipes.title: Pixel slice word reveal
recipes.summary: A flat blue hold snaps to a brand-pink frame, then band and column slices tear through a dot grid until one word assembles from coarse pink pixel blocks over a pale field, a small URL settling under it. Under 3 s, edgy.
use_when: A short tech or developer brand intro where the name is the only copy
A sting before or after a longer film, 2-3 s
Social loops that need a hard, digital-feeling reveal of one word
Silent autoplay where a colour snap has to stop the scroll

recipes.title: Point to line to plan to built place
recipes.summary: A single dot stretches into a line, the line draws a floor plan, the plan tilts into 3D and extrudes into lit volumes inside a growing site, with figure callouts and two short statements, then rewinds to the line and the wordmark.
use_when: Architecture, real estate, construction or spatial-design products that turn drawings into places
A build-from-nothing story where the object assembles in one continuous camera move
A slow, premium loop for a site hero or showroom screen
Showing 3-4 project figures over a hero object without a UI

recipes.title: Portal letter dive into a light tunnel
recipes.summary: One word on a pale page; its round letter is a live window into a blue vortex. The camera dives through it in 8 frames, then two short lines rise from depth and leave past the camera, so the tunnel reads as space.
use_when: A 3 s teaser or opener that has to feel like going somewhere, not a wipe
The hook word has a round glyph or a dot that can become a window
Naming a product after one setup line, no UI yet
A light-to-dark contrast flip to open a darker film

recipes.title: Social post card quote settle
recipes.summary: One white social-post card on a blue diagonal gradient: avatar and footer land first, name and handle rise, the two-line quote sweeps in word by word within 1 s, then the card holds still and fades out. Social proof in one calm beat.
use_when: Sharing one user quote or public post as social proof
A square feed clip that must read as a real platform post
A short insert between feature shots in a longer launch film
Silent autoplay where one sentence carries the message

recipes.title: Poster flicker montage loop
recipes.summary: About 28 full-bleed vertical posters hard-cut every 2 to 14 frames (4 cuts per second), with 2 to 3 frame interstitial frames, slice glitches and a white flash as accents; it ends on the opening poster so it loops.
use_when: A studio or designer showreel built from finished poster or cover work
A launch-day vertical teaser where volume of work is the message
A seamless loop for a social profile, story or event screen
A silent autoplay feed where no copy needs to be read

recipes.title: Tilted UI plane feature tour
recipes.summary: A dark product interface travels past the camera in six capability stops, cuts to a resource grid, then resolves into a glowing mark, short promise, and typed URL.
use_when: A multi-screen product needs a compact capability tour
The interface can be rebuilt as one continuous spatial canvas
A silent launch cut needs readable UI and a clear closing URL

recipes.title: Prompt gallery proof reel
recipes.summary: A typed request opens a vertical reel, a dense gallery and rolling count prove breadth, one example becomes a branching workflow, and a compact mark-and-URL close converts the proof into action.
use_when: a vertical developer-tool promo needs a fast proof of breadth
a product can show many visual examples before one focused workflow
a voice-over needs clear visual chapters without a music bed

recipes.title: Dark prompt, model menu, typed code, mark close
recipes.summary: A glowing mark drops into a dark frame and becomes a lockup, then one continuous camera pushes over a prompt bar: typing, a model menu pick, send, a spinner, a code window typing itself, which collapses back into the mark.
use_when: Launching an AI assistant or model picker where the prompt UI is the hero
A coding assistant that should show one request turn into code
Silent autoplay: the story reads from UI states alone, no VO
A dark, serif, restrained brand that wants one unbroken shot

recipes.title: Prompt orbit story with a guided light trail
recipes.summary: A soft orb carries one continuous story from a portrait into a typed prompt, an orbiting media mosaic, short claims, selectable outputs, and a restrained mark close.
use_when: a 20–30 s launch film led by one visual guide
a creative tool that turns one input into several outputs
a brand story that needs media examples without full product UI
a light-background film with continuous morph transitions

recipes.title: Prompt to preview card, revised twice
recipes.summary: A question types itself word by word, a prompt field grows from a dot and types a request, then a page preview card appears and changes on two short follow-up prompts before a word-by-word close and a mark.
use_when: A generator product where one prompt produces a visible result
Showing that the result can be revised with short follow-up instructions
A silent dark teaser of 15-20 s with one question, one demo and one close
There is no real UI yet: the result is a coloured stand-in card

recipes.title: Prompt retype, send, streamed answer, mark close
recipes.summary: A lone prompt bar on light grey: one question is typed and erased, a second is typed and sent with a cursor click, the view drops to a chat thread where a long answer streams and scrolls, then the brand mark holds.
use_when: An AI writing or chat product that wants a 10 s silent loop of ask, answer, mark
Showing that the assistant writes long-form output fast
A minimal, monochrome brand that should feel like a native chat UI
A feed teaser where the prompt itself is the hook

recipes.title: Prompt typed big, then bloomed into a step list
recipes.summary: A wordmark on a green gradient erases into big typing with a colour trail, cuts to the same line in a small prompt bar, then the bar blooms into a card whose tagged steps write themselves in under a second.
use_when: An agent or automation product that turns one instruction into a plan of steps
A short silent intro (about 5 s) for a feed or a landing hero loop
Showing input and structured output as one continuous object, no cut to a new scene
A light, calm brand where colour-coded tags can carry meaning

recipes.title: Prompt, punch-in send, agent thinks, result lands
recipes.summary: A white prompt pill types one request fast on a warm mesh gradient, holds, punches in on the send button for a slow cursor and a 3-frame press, then cuts to the chat: agent header, thinking lines, spinner, a code card and a shimmer.
use_when: An AI agent or assistant product that turns one prompt into a result
A short 5 s social loop or the opener of a longer AI product film
A light, warm consumer brand that wants the UI to feel soft and premium
Showing that the product is working without a progress bar

recipes.title: Dark prompt card types, zooms in, cursor presses send
