recipes.summary: A small dark prompt card types a two-line request at speed, the camera springs in toward its left half, then a pointer slides up and presses the blue send button. A 4.5 s silent loop of one prompt being written and sent.
use_when: Showing that an AI tool starts from one typed request
A short insert before a result or answer scene
Silent autoplay social clip for a prompt-driven product
Opening beat of a longer ai-chat film

recipes.title: Receding digits on the beat, then a launch lockup
recipes.summary: Five oversized gradient digits descend to one, each arriving blurred on a music beat and sinking into depth; a hard cut lands a name-plus-status lockup on near-black with a violet light ribbon, then a short sign-off line.
use_when: Announcing that a product, feature or event has just launched
A short opener before a longer launch film, built on a slow 80-90 BPM track
A teaser where there is no UI to show yet, only the name
Social or event screens that need a number sequence hook in under 4 s

recipes.title: Replayed-prefix statement swap to URL close
recipes.summary: One centred line on dark navy, then the same line replays with only its last word changed, then an eyebrow and a big URL, then an availability close. A drifting blue light arc keeps the empty frame alive.
use_when: A site or portal launch where the URL itself is the hero line
Saying the product fits two audiences with one sentence and a changed last word
Silent autoplay feeds where type carries the whole message
A calm, restrained voice on a dark brand

recipes.title: Rim-lit tilted page section tour
recipes.summary: Four sections of a dark storefront page glide past on a tilted plane lit by bright edge bars, one hard cut each, then a gold mark card, a plain wordmark and the whole page shrunk into a phone. Only the camera moves.
use_when: A premium or luxury storefront or landing page with a dark theme and a metal-coloured accent
Silent autoplay showcase of an existing website, section by section
The page already looks good and only needs a camera, not new animation
Closing on the logo plus a mobile view of the same page

recipes.title: Ring fill with a climbing percentage
recipes.summary: One thin ring on a flat saturated field fills clockwise from 12 o'clock while the centred percentage counts up in sync, fast through the middle and crawling into the last points. A single stat lands without any other element.
use_when: One headline figure (accuracy, uptime, completion) needs its own short beat
A loading or processing moment inside a longer product film
A loopable social tile or stat card for a feed
Silent autoplay where the number must read without VO

recipes.title: Ring-built mark into hero product drop
recipes.summary: A mark grows from a dot inside concentric pill-shaped hairlines, splits apart, and hard-cuts to a floating hero product under a frame-wide name that stretches off screen, then a white end card with a typed caption.
use_when: A physical product launch with one strong cutout photo or render
The brand mark has two halves or a symmetric shape that can split
A short 4:5 or 9:16 social teaser of about 6-7 s
E-commerce drops where the build-up matters more than features

recipes.title: Word flips across a hairline rule
recipes.summary: A thin rule appears on white, one short line rises out from behind it, leans a few degrees, flips under the rule like a hinge, leans the other way, then slips back behind it. One line, one rule, four seconds.
use_when: A short title card or chapter marker where the type is the whole picture
Introducing a product name or a two-word label in a calm, minimal voice
A loopable lower-energy sting between longer scenes
Silent autoplay feeds that need motion without SFX

recipes.title: Ruled feature grid cascade
recipes.summary: Four short feature points in a 2x2 grid on black. Each item's blue hairline draws from the left, then its three lines rise out of a clip mask in reading order; the grid holds, then rules retract and text fades.
use_when: A product page or pitch slide needs four short benefits shown at once
A text-only section between product shots in a longer film
A silent loop for a website hero or social feed
Points of equal weight that should read in a fixed order

recipes.title: Shard letters assemble, zoom, image drop
recipes.summary: Four bold one-word lines assemble from tilted letter shards on flat cream, hold, then a fast zoom pushes the outer lines off frame and a key-art still drops into the gap between the two middle words.
use_when: A release-date teaser for a show, drop or launch day
A 2-3 s silent feed loop that ends on one key image
Announcing what is coming and when, before showing it

recipes.title: Illustrated card assembles in layers, holds, fades
recipes.summary: A single portrait card scales in on a blush background, its title rises out of a mask and the illustrated scene builds layer by layer from the bottom; copy fades in, the scene settles, holds 2 s and fades out to loop.
use_when: Showing one app card, desktop panel or onboarding screen as a calm hero moment
A square loop for a feed or a landing page tile
A product whose screen carries illustration that can be split into depth layers
Silent autoplay where one name and one short line are enough

recipes.title: Two-lane screen column drift
recipes.summary: Nine product screens of mixed sizes (wide, square, tall) rise through the frame in a staggered two-lane column at a constant speed, each lane a touch faster or slower, so a long screen tour reads as one calm, continuous scroll.
use_when: A product overview with many screens and no single hero view
Showing web and mobile layouts of one product side by side
A silent loop for a site hero, a booth screen or a showreel interlude
Background plate behind a statement or logo in a longer film

recipes.title: Screen-lit laptop in three slow moves
recipes.summary: A dark laptop on pure black, lit only by its own interface, filmed in three equal 5.2 s shots: a low truck across the screen, a push-in on the chart, a pull-out to the whole device. Darkness and foreground keyboard blur sell the macro lens.
use_when: A premium, quiet product teaser for a desktop or web app with one strong dashboard screen
A silent autoplay loop or hero background where nothing should flash or cut fast
The UI has a chart or progress panel worth a close detail shot
Opening or closing a longer film on the product in its device

recipes.title: Round button opens into a search field
recipes.summary: A round magnifier button on a violet gradient is tapped, stretches right into a wide field while its glyph flips into a caret, idles with a blinking caret, then folds back into the button. A seamless 6 s loop for search entry points.
use_when: Introducing a search or command input before showing results
A looping hero or social clip for a product whose entry point is one field
An intro beat in a longer UI film, followed by a typing shot
Silent autoplay where one tidy UI gesture has to carry the frame

recipes.title: Footage window that morphs through shapes
recipes.summary: A small rectangle opens on a flat pastel field and grows into a portrait window onto footage, then bends through a notched bow, a twisting pinwheel and a square before locking into an hourglass. The clip never cuts; the mask is the motion.
use_when: Opening a film on one strong clip without a hard cut
Silent loop or social teaser where a single shot needs more life
A mask transition into hero footage or a product video
Brands with a geometric mark the final shape can echo

recipes.title: Sketch-to-photo divider glide
recipes.summary: A line-drawing layer and the finished photo of the same scene share one frame; a thin divider with a pill handle glides left, rests, comes back to centre, then returns home, so the viewer compares plan and result in one shot.
use_when: Showing a transformation: plan vs result, draft vs final, raw vs edited
Interior, renovation, retouch or design-tool reels where both states share one framing
A square or vertical feed loop with no cuts and a short two-line promise
Proof beat inside a longer film: the before/after carries the claim

recipes.title: Sky mark wipe into version dive
recipes.summary: A frosted mark settles over drifting sky footage, slides aside to wipe on the product name with its version, the sky washes to white and a huge thin version number holds, then the camera dives into it.
use_when: Announcing a major version of an existing product (2.0, v3) in a vertical feed
A short silent brand sting before a longer release film
The brand has a compact mark and an airy, light identity
You have one calm background clip (sky, water, texture) and no UI to show

recipes.title: Slot-word statements with passing UI card stacks
recipes.summary: Three short white statements on black with blue corner glows; one slot word swaps while stacks of product cards slide across and up through the frame, then split to reveal a glowing card edge and cut to black.
use_when: A service or agent product with a landing page and one dashboard panel to show
Silent social or landing-page loop where type carries the message and UI is texture
Positioning line with one swappable role word (assistant, employee, teammate)
Dark brand with one saturated accent colour for the glow

recipes.title: Brand guide tour: specimen push, swatch dolly, lockup
recipes.summary: One-shot identity walkthrough on pale grey: title blurs in, a two-font specimen pushes toward camera, five swatches cascade in, the camera zooms on them and dollies across, a mood board, then a lockup holds.
use_when: Presenting a new visual identity or a brand guide to a client
A portfolio piece that shows fonts, colours and a closing lockup in 15 s
Silent autoplay where calm type and flat colour carry the film
Opening a longer identity presentation before detailed pages

recipes.title: Spinning blur headline over contracting rings
recipes.summary: A two-line headline spins and sharpens out of a heavy blur while it falls back in depth, over concentric rounded rings that keep shrinking. One unbroken 2 s move with a slow middle gives a short claim depth.
use_when: A one-claim feature announcement or availability line
A 2 s sting before or after a longer film
A silent loop for social feeds where one headline is the whole message
Introducing something with a depth or immersion angle

recipes.title: Spinner that pops into a success check
recipes.summary: A small loading spinner on a pale track ring snaps into a filled disc that pops to 2.7x with a check, holds, then clock-wipes back into a pie spinner. A 4 s loop for the done moment after any action.
use_when: The confirm beat right after a submit, upload or payment in a product demo
A looping micro-interaction tile for a feature grid or social post
Bridging a loading state to a result in a longer UI film
A silent, monochrome brand that wants one clear state change

recipes.title: Split band photo reveal to wordmark
recipes.summary: From black, a thin vertical slit opens into side-by-side photo bands that swap images every quarter second, then part to uncover a full-frame texture shot where a bold wordmark rises out of a baseline mask and holds.
use_when: A fashion, beauty or lifestyle brand with strong photography and a text wordmark
A 6 s opener or chapter change that ends on the name
Teasing several product or mood photos before one hero image
Silent autoplay where the picture carries the energy

recipes.title: Card stack fan into a vertical filmstrip reel
recipes.summary: A dot grows into a small rounded image card, fans into a column of four, folds back, then the front card grows to full bleed. Four full-bleed images slide down one after another under a rolling index number, closing on a framed title card.
use_when: A vertical portfolio or gallery reel of 3-6 strong images or app screens
Social or store asset where the visuals carry the message and copy is one title
Opening a showcase by previewing every item at once before showing each full screen
Silent autoplay where motion alone has to read as a sequence

recipes.title: Stacked sample cards into an editor zoom tour
recipes.summary: Two stacked cards show finished sample clips, a feed post proves reach with a climbing view count, then the camera dives through an editor: typed prompts, a step list, a tilted gallery, layer swaps. Mark tile, URL and offer close it.
use_when: A vertical promo for a creative or video tool that has finished outputs worth showing first
VO-led social ad (about 40 s) that walks three ways to use the product
The product has a canvas plus timeline UI that reads well in punch-ins
Closing on an integration: your mark plus a partner mark side by side

recipes.title: Stat cards stacking over moody footage
recipes.summary: Four rounded stat cards rise one over another on dim monochrome footage, each a different fill with a mono label and one big figure, every 0.8 s; then a hard cut to a two-line word-by-word close on black.
use_when: A fitness, health or tracking product with three to five headline figures
Short silent social promo (4:5 feed) that has to show results in under 4 s
A metric recap where each figure gets its own colour
Footage of the activity exists but no UI recording does

recipes.title: Stat tiles conveyor over product footage
recipes.summary: Rounded app widgets ride a single row over blurred monochrome product footage: every ~1.55 s the row steps one slot left, a new tile lands on the right and types its data in. Ends on a two-line word-by-word close on black.
use_when: A fitness, health or tracking app whose value is a handful of personal stats
Vertical social promo where the app has widgets worth more than a full screen
You have one moody product or lifestyle clip and want UI layered over it
Silent autoplay: the data and the close carry the message without VO

recipes.title: Stat wall erodes into a completion card
recipes.summary: One result figure tiles the whole frame, blinks, then erodes glyph by glyph to black; a bold two-line done headline lands, rises to the top, and a mono stat list types in beside a growing track icon.
use_when: Closing beat of a flow: a workout, task or order has just been completed
A single hero number deserves a loud entrance before the detail
Silent vertical or 4:5 feed posts for fitness, tracking or productivity apps
A reward screen recap with three to five labelled stats

recipes.title: Keynote statement launch
recipes.summary: Four short statements on a flat background, one every 2.6 s: eyebrow and name, two claims, then availability with the URL. Per-word blur-drop entrances and a slow scale creep keep calm type alive.
use_when: The product is announced before there is UI worth showing
A silent autoplay feed where the type has to carry the whole message
Opening or closing a longer film with three or four claims
A premium, restrained brand voice (no hype, no SFX)

recipes.title: Stepped band wave wipes open to a typed intro card
recipes.summary: Thick accent bands stepped like a bar graph swell across a light grid, split and slide off top and bottom, uncovering a white card where an eyebrow word types with a block caret, then the name and an accent product line type in.
use_when: a 3 s brand sting before a product demo
announcing a named product or dataset with one accent phrase
a light, technical brand with one strong accent colour

recipes.title: Store download badge assembles on black
recipes.summary: A black download badge builds piece by piece on black: the rounded outline scales up, the store mark fades in, then the two label lines rise word by word inside the frame. It holds, then fades and shrinks out.
use_when: a 2-4 s download CTA insert at the end of a mobile app film
an end-card overlay that tells viewers where to get the app
a silent, monochrome sign-off that must not compete with the logo

recipes.title: Store tap into a feature relay with ring and orbit
recipes.summary: A store listing is tapped, then the app answers in fast single-idea shots: twin phones swing in, a card flips, a chart counts up, a band types a claim, a ring fills, coins orbit a globe, and the wordmark wipes on. Each shot under 2.3 s.
use_when: A finance or wallet app launch that needs several capabilities shown in 15 s
Silent feed autoplay where each shot must carry one idea without VO
A store-download push: the film opens on the listing and the tap
Brands with one saturated accent per scene on black and white grounds

recipes.title: Swinging card over a stepping feature list
recipes.summary: A tall all-caps list of one-word features steps down the square frame while a payment card swings to a new tilt and colour at each stop. One hero object plus a wall of capabilities, read in under 4 s.
use_when: A card, pass or badge product with many small capabilities to name at once
A short square loop for a feed, landing page hero or plan comparison
Silent autoplay where one object and single words carry the message
Showing several colour or tier variants of the same physical object

recipes.title: Tablet wall dive with sliding screen reel
recipes.summary: The camera pushes from a wall of landscape tablets into the centre one; its screens slide down one after another every 1.5 s, the strip showing past the bezel, then the camera pulls back out to the wall.
use_when: Showing 3-5 screens of a tablet or landscape app without any copy
A short silent loop for a product page, gallery or social feed
Placeholder-first: screenshots are ready but there is no story or VO yet
Opening a longer device showcase with a wall-to-hero camera move

recipes.title: Teaser card peeking out of an artboard collage
recipes.summary: A still collage of design artboards over giant cropped type; a cursor drifts to one artboard, a teaser card grows out of it with a masked three-line headline and pill buttons, folds back, then repeats from a second artboard.
use_when: Pre-launch teaser where the feature itself must stay hidden
Design, template or creative tools whose output is a set of artboards or formats
Silent social loop that announces a release date or waitlist
Short looping header or hero clip for a launch page

recipes.title: Vertical editor walkthrough: pick, swap, tilt, retype
recipes.summary: A vertical product tour of a motion editor: a template is picked from a gallery, its phone screen is swapped, tilted and recoloured, a headline is retyped, then URL and mark close. Each step is one visible edit, paced to the VO.
use_when: Showing a creative or design tool end to end in one vertical clip
A template or remix product where the edit itself is the payoff
VO-led tutorials where every sentence maps to one UI action
Reels or shorts that need a product demo under 50 s

recipes.title: App tile mark spin-resolve sting
recipes.summary: A black rounded app tile fades in over a soft iridescent gradient, its white line mark spins out of a blur into focus, holds, then dissolves back and the tile shrinks away. A 3 s silent loop for an icon moment.
use_when: A short logo sting or loop for an app whose icon is a single-colour mark on a solid tile
Opening or closing a longer film on the app icon
A silent social or website loop that returns to the empty background
An AI or abstract product whose mark reads as a knot, swirl or radial glyph

recipes.title: Tilted disc row, one flip every three seconds
recipes.summary: Six thick translucent red discs stand in a diagonal row on black under a red glow; every 3 s one disc, out of order, spins through edge-on to broad face and re-seats. A calm, loopable object loop with no copy.
use_when: A loopable dark background or interstitial between scenes of a longer film
A brand whose mark is a coin, token, chip or disc shape
A silent autoplay tile that needs slow, regular life without text
A hold under an end card or a lower-third where motion must stay calm

recipes.title: Tilted docs tour with a travelling focus band
recipes.summary: A dark product UI leaned back in 3D, the camera trucking slowly and linearly across it while a narrow focus band sits on one element per shot; eight UI shots, then a flat mark and a flat wordmark.
use_when: A developer tool or docs product whose UI is the story and there is no VO
Calm, premium product tour where reading speed matters more than energy
Several UI states (landing, article, search, API page) to show in under 25 s
Dark UI with one accent colour that survives heavy vignetting

recipes.title: Tilted picture wheel turning through a centred label
recipes.summary: About 22 square images ride a vertical wheel seen side-on, scaled 4x from far to near, crossing in front of and behind one centred line of type on white. One slow, even turn per loop; the line blurs in and out word by word.
use_when: a seamless loop for a gallery, template pack or asset library
showing many images or outputs around one short claim
a calm feature beat inside a longer film where depth comes from scale, not 3D
muted autoplay feeds that need constant motion without cuts

recipes.title: Tilted phone to laptop tour with typed captions
recipes.summary: Dark, silent 30 s promo: a mark lockup, three tilted phone close-ups each paired with a short green caption typed letter by letter, a four-line stacked statement, then a laptop pull-out and a closing mark.
use_when: A consumer app that ships on phone and desktop and wants one film for both
Silent autoplay feeds where green-on-black captions carry the message
You have 3 phone screenshots and 1 desktop screenshot, no UI rebuild
A dark brand with one saturated accent colour

recipes.title: Tilted send button pressed by a hand cursor
recipes.summary: A corner of an empty prompt card, leaned in perspective, fills a vertical frame; a hand cursor glides onto the round send button, presses it with a squash and slides away. A 2.8 s loopable micro-moment.
use_when: A short vertical loop that teases sending a prompt without showing an answer
The press moment inside a longer AI product film, before a thinking or result beat
Social stories where one tap is the whole message
A product whose primary action is a single round button

recipes.title: Tilted dark site: hero, chat, metrics
recipes.summary: A dark violet landing page leaned back in 3D, cut twice: hero headline under a slow push, an assistant chat panel panning left, then the chat beside four metric tiles drifting right. Three planes, no type animation, all motion is camera.
use_when: A service or agency site with a hero, an assistant and a results block
Short silent teaser where the UI itself is the whole story
Dark brand with a single violet or blue accent
B-roll under VO or a social post, 10 s, no copy beyond the UI

recipes.title: Tinted-panel phone close-ups, icon then wordmark
recipes.summary: A light phone leaned back in perspective, five shallow-focus close-ups, each screen on its own slanted pastel panel and drifting slowly. Hard cuts between screens, then a quiet close: icon alone, then wordmark alone, on white.
use_when: A mobile app with four or five distinct screens and a calm, clean brand
Silent autoplay feeds where each screen must read on its own for about 3.5 s
Showing breadth of an app (account, onboarding, support, main screen) without a narrative
A pastel per-screen colour code is wanted to separate features

recipes.title: Toggle-driven old/new mark swap loop
recipes.summary: A two-label pill switch at the top flips and the centred mark swaps: the old mark swells, shrinks and fades, the new one fades in and grows into place. Then it flips back, so the 5 s loop shows a rebrand as one tap.
use_when: Announcing a rebrand or a new logo next to the old one
A square social loop that compares two versions of one thing
A v2 reveal where the change itself is the message
A short silent autoplay post with no copy beyond two labels

recipes.title: Turntable card stack spin
recipes.summary: Four large square cards lie overlapped on black and the whole stack turns like a turntable: a slow constant drift, then a quick ramped step that brings the next card to the front, twice in 8 s. Constant motion with two accents.
use_when: Showing three to five finished visuals (posts, covers, product shots) as one set
A silent loop for a portfolio, template pack or feature tier page
A background plate behind a headline that needs motion but no story
Any brand with strong flat colour where the cards carry the palette

recipes.title: Twin phone dashboard build-up
recipes.summary: Two bezel-less phone screens fade up on a light stage, then a finance dashboard assembles itself: tinted metric cards with rolling numbers and rings, rising bars, a 2x2 stat grid. Holds on a slow push, fades out to an empty loop.
use_when: Showing a finance, sales or analytics mobile app in one short loop
A silent autoplay shot for a landing page hero or a social card
Proving the product tracks numbers: metrics, progress and a chart on one screen
Opening a longer film with a calm, light product reveal

recipes.title: Recursive type stack zoom loop
recipes.summary: A two-word lockup repeated as a shrinking column of copies on black; the front copy zooms up and out of frame while the next one grows into its place, so one second loops without a seam.
use_when: A seamless loop for a social post, story sticker or website hero
An intro or outro sting built from a two-word name or slogan
A type-only background behind a talk, stream or event screen
Hypnotic filler between scenes of a longer film

recipes.title: Typed intro, skill words on tilted screens, desk pull-out
recipes.summary: A personal showcase: a caret types a greeting and a name on flat light grey, then each skill word cascades in beside a tilted screen of that work, and the profile page is pushed in, panned and pulled back onto a desk monitor.
use_when: A freelancer or creator introducing themselves and three to four skills
A portfolio reel built from screenshots rather than footage
A profile or cover-image showcase that needs to end on the full page in context
Voice-over intros where the type follows the speaker word by word

recipes.title: Typed name, rising phone, benefit chips
recipes.summary: The app name types itself on a warm glow, a phone rises over it, tilts and sprouts three one-word benefit chips, then a macro close-up and a side profile with shallow focus before a short call to action and the name again.
use_when: A consumer mobile app with one strong home screen to show
Vertical feeds where the product name must land in the first second
Three one-word benefits (speed, safety, trust) that fit on chips
A silent autoplay promo with a warm, friendly brand colour

recipes.title: Typed problem to tilted dashboard with stepped capabilities
recipes.summary: A caret types the pain on white, a short phrase types its accent word, the product name fades in, then a tilted dashboard card slides in and a pointer steps through three capability rows before the labels clear and one icon holds.
use_when: A service product whose story is one pain, one name, one dashboard
Silent feed teaser where typing carries the problem without VO
Showing three capabilities next to a single hero screen
Light, calm SaaS brands with one accent colour

recipes.title: Vertical editor walkthrough on tilted planes with VO
recipes.summary: A creator-style vertical promo: VO talks through a browser tool while the camera whips and pushes across tilted UI planes, from site to template, edit, export, then a glinting URL on a blue blob field.
use_when: A web tool or editor explained in a 30-45 s vertical reel with voice-over
Showing a 4-step flow (browse, pick, edit, export) without cutting to talking heads
Creator or affiliate-style posts that end on a URL instead of a logo
Product has real UI screenshots of several screens

recipes.title: Voice query panel loop
recipes.summary: A wordmark pill grows a mic button, a cursor taps it, the pill swells into a frosted panel where a spoken question resolves letter by letter, thinks, streams an answer and settles into a checked list, then folds back.
use_when: An assistant or search product whose hero moment is speaking a question
A loopable vertical clip for a landing page hero or a social feed
Showing the full ask, think, answer cycle in one calm continuous shot
A silent autoplay demo where the UI states carry the story

recipes.title: Voice request handed to an orb agent
recipes.summary: On a pale blue field a caret writes a two-line hook, a voice tile grows into a live transcript, a glowing orb answers, then shrinks into an activity card and fans out into reply bubbles in many languages. One continuous camera, no cuts.
use_when: A voice or phone agent that takes a spoken request and acts on it
Showing one request travelling from input to answer to logged result in a single shot
A calm, light, silent product teaser where UI pieces morph into each other
Multilingual support as the closing capability

recipes.title: Wallpaper prompt tour with lens wipes and monitor close
recipes.summary: A one-word mark types over flower footage, a ring opens onto a desktop wallpaper where a prompt is typed and sent, then a desk with a capability scroll, a glass-lens headline over autumn footage and a monitor end card.
use_when: An AI assistant or productivity tool that wants a friendly, nostalgic look instead of dark UI
Showing one prompt being asked, then many things the tool covers
A 30 s social cut that ends on a URL and a logo on a device
Brands with a mascot or small mark that can sit alone on screen

recipes.title: Waveform lanes, button pair and review pins
recipes.summary: One white shot, three UI states: waveform clips settle into colour lanes and one is dragged, two action buttons pop out of each other, then stretch into a glowing line where pins type review notes. Ends on a name.
use_when: An audio or video editing tool announcing a version
A product whose story is edit, send out, collect feedback
A short silent feature teaser built only from rebuilt UI pieces
Light, clean brand with a few saturated accent colours

recipes.title: Credit line, window rise, sidebar zoom
recipes.summary: A two-word credit line on white hands over to a rounded app window that rises from below, a two-word title lands above it, then the camera snaps in on the window's sidebar menu and holds so every item can be read.
use_when: Announcing one navigation or menu change inside an existing chat or app UI
A short silent teaser that ends on a readable UI detail instead of a logo
Light, restrained product voice with one camera move
Opening shot of a longer UI walkthrough

recipes.title: Spring-gap word poster
recipes.summary: A left-aligned event poster on black: each word lands from a wide gap and springs tight against its neighbours, the block squeezes once more, then the words fling out left one after another. Two short lines, a footer URL and a corner mark.
use_when: Announcing an event, date or launch day as a single poster frame
A short looping opener for a feed post or story
A bold one-statement teaser with no UI to show
Silent autoplay where type and rhythm carry the message

recipes.title: Giant wordmark gradient flood and pan
recipes.summary: The camera travels across an outlined wordmark taller than the frame while a sunrise gradient floods the letters, flips to dark letters cut out of the gradient field, then lands as a small gradient-filled wordmark on navy.
use_when: A brand intro where the colour gradient is part of the identity
A short vertical sting before or after a longer film
A name of 3 to 6 letters with bold, wide shapes
Silent autoplay feeds: no copy beyond the name

recipes.title: Lockup word unfold over still footage
recipes.summary: A small mark and one-word wordmark sit centred on a full-bleed travel plate; a second, lighter word unfolds to the right as the lockup re-centres, holds, then folds back. Quiet, loopable brand sting.
use_when: A brand whose short name expands to a longer name or category (name + descriptor)
A loopable 5 s sting over hero photography or a calm footage plate
Silent autoplay intro where only the mark has to register
Travel, mobility or hospitality identities with strong imagery
